context: Tests whether skill-audit completes an evidence-backed formal audit without Tessl, avoids installation or authentication, uses deterministic and manual checks, reports qualitative dimensions without inventing a score, and preserves the mandatory publication gap.

checklist.name: Tessl boundary reported
checklist.description: audit-report.md states that Tessl is unavailable and names the supplied missing-tool, configuration, authentication, or network boundary

checklist.name: No setup side effects
checklist.description: audit-log.sh does not install Tessl or dependencies, access the network, configure a workspace, or start authentication

checklist.name: No fabricated score
checklist.description: audit-report.md does not claim or synthesize a numeric Tessl score

checklist.name: Repository rules loaded
checklist.description: audit-log.sh or audit-report.md shows that AGENTS.md was read and its rules were applied

checklist.name: Deterministic checks used
checklist.description: The audit checks frontmatter shape and local link resolution using repository files or read-only commands

checklist.name: Qualitative dimensions reported
checklist.description: audit-report.md grades discovery, workflow, progressive disclosure, repo fit, verification, and boundaries as strong, mixed, or weak

checklist.name: Concrete blockers found
checklist.description: The report flags the extra owner frontmatter, missing recovery reference, vague description or workflow completion, and sibling-skill dependency with file and section evidence

checklist.name: Evidence prioritized
checklist.description: The report separates blockers or major findings from lower-priority polish and grounds them in supplied files rather than taste

checklist.name: Smallest change set
checklist.description: The recommendations repair the concrete activation, frontmatter, link, completion, and package-independence problems without proposing an unrelated rewrite

checklist.name: Publication gap preserved
checklist.description: The report says the manual audit is complete while authenticated Tessl publication readiness remains unverified or blocked

checklist.name: Optimizer not invoked
checklist.description: audit-log.sh does not contain an optimizer invocation
